concepts.name: brood
concepts.definition: Eggs, larvae and pupae, together. How much there is, and at what stage, tells you how the colony is doing.

refs.how: Reads the brood on a frame to judge the queen.
Weighs what an inspection costs the brood against what it shows.

concepts.name: the brood clock
concepts.definition: How long each kind of bee takes from egg to emerging. It sets every deadline at the hive.

refs.how: Dates the queen's last laying from eggs, which hatch within three days.

concepts.name: jobs by age
concepts.definition: A worker moves from cleaning cells to nursing, building and guarding, and forages last.

concepts.name: inspection
concepts.definition: Opening a hive to look at its frames, with one question to answer each time.

refs.how: Sets a monitor against the inspection it might replace.

concepts.name: reading a frame
concepts.definition: Looking over one frame in a fixed order: eggs, larvae, sealed brood, then stores.

concepts.name: hive scale
concepts.definition: A scale under the hive that logs its weight, so you see the nectar flow and a swarm leaving.
